capabilities: Run work, focus, microbreak, recovery and long break sessions with idle and sleep-gap handling
Track Health, Stamina, Hydration and Food game bars with XP and progressive levels
Schedule hydration, meal, snack and movement check-ins with snoozeable reminders
Show daily quests, weekly goals and dashboard statistics
Export stats as JSON and CSV and reset or import data
disambiguation: Not a health or medical app; Health, Stamina, Hydration and Food are fictional game indicators based on configured routines.
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugin browser; installs via BRAT, manual GitHub release, or building from source. Runs fully locally with no account, cloud backend or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pace work sessions with recovery breaks or to make work rhythm and healthy habits visible during the day.

relations.evidence: BRAT is the easiest way to install and update beta Obsidian plugins from GitHub.

summary: Gamified work-rhythm HUD that times focus sessions and prompts breaks, hydration, meals and movement, with XP, levels, quests and a statusbar display.
